jobs.title: Sunday · Newport, 2 AM
jobs.prompt: a full-page Sunday comic in horizontal tiers stacked top to bottom, each tier one wide panel (4 tiers). Style: comic Sunday page tier, confident brush-and-ink line over wet-on-wet watercolor washes on cold-press paper, Pacific Northwest coastal light, gray-green moss, fog, rusted galvanized tin, water bleeding softly over the ink edge. Cast, the same faces, hair and builds in every panel, ages exactly as given: WOOD — aged 38, lean man, hairline beginning to recede, weathered jaw, thickened drawing hands; CHLOE — aged 38, woman with a sharp face, dark hair pinned up, faint eyeliner, straight posture, a plain ring with a small stone. Clothes, hair-dos and anything held come from this strip's description, never from the reference sheet; hands are empty unless a panel names what they hold. Title of the strip: DRIFT WOOD. The strip: The 24-hour diner in Newport. Wood and the strip's Chloe at 2 AM. Thirty years of dialect. No exposition. Tier 1: a 24-hour roadside diner at 2 AM in wet-on-wet watercolor, lit windows in a dark lot with an old Subaru wagon and a rental car, two figures in a booth seen through the glass (in this tier: WOOD, CHLOE). No dialogue in this tier. Tier 2: a woman with pinned dark hair and a man in a plaid flannel across a diner booth at night with two coffees and an untouched plate of fries, tired kind faces, watercolor (in this tier: CHLOE, WOOD). Chloe says "Corn or peas.". Wood says "You remember that.". Chloe says "I remember everything. It's the problem.". Tier 3: close-up of two hands on a diner table not touching, a ring on one, a plate of fries, night (in this tier: CHLOE, WOOD). Wood says "How's the brand narrative.". Chloe says "Thirty years of packaging for things nobody needed. Give or take.". Wood says "It's been twenty.". Chloe says "It's been thirty, Wood. I count from the cafeteria.". Tier 4: the same diner from outside later with the booth empty and two cars pulling out of the lot in opposite directions, a clock reading 3:40 through the window, watercolor, no words. No dialogue in this tier. Lettering: every balloon and caption contains its complete text exactly as written, in clean hand-lettered comic capitals, large enough to read; size each balloon to fit its whole sentence and never cut a word at a balloon or panel edge; no words other than the ones given. Bottom right margin: tiny signature "A. Finch — Small Wood, OR" beside a tiny stylized crab, seen from above. Reference @chloe_34 is the model sheet for CHLOE: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @dw_2014_12_21_the_box is the model sheet for WOOD: match that face, hair and build exactly; do NOT copy its clothes, pose or props — those come from the strip text above. Reference @objects_vehicles_food is a finished strip in this style. Match the attached references: @chloe_34 for the character the strip's Chloe at 34; @dw_2014_12_21_the_box for a finished strip in this style; @objects_vehicles_food for the objects.
